fix:
Open toward 10.
(1) The metal's light: hard 1-2 px sun glints on the back-left corners of the link tops and on the prongs, and shade on the back links' camera-facing walls. These need a listing shot under a hard back-left light, because a 2-D relight cannot place them.
(2) The notch: the correct fix tests sun visibility in 3-D. It would check each link point against each sweet's sphere (known from the circle fits, the contacts and the sun vector 0.43,0.66) instead of reading the ground at the link's foot. This is untested. I tested two screen-space shortcuts in a private copy, /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-naira-scroll/81f6e48f-a340-5398-99b2-f7e22fb69d37/scratchpad/review6/tools/comp_prism_v8.py (the installed comp_prism.py plus options; its defaults reproduce the live plate with a maximum difference of 0), and rejected both:
- footocc=1 treats feet hidden behind a sweet as lit (render /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-naira-scroll/81f6e48f-a340-5398-99b2-f7e22fb69d37/scratchpad/review6/var/r4_footocc.png). It leaves the notch unchanged, because those feet are not hidden, and it puts a hard vertical seam on the back links above the pink sweet at x about 470.
- shcap=1 caps the shade at the scene's full-shadow colour (render /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-naira-scroll/81f6e48f-a340-5398-99b2-f7e22fb69d37/scratchpad/review6/var/r4_shcap.png). Leave the notch as it is unless the 3-D test is done; it is invisible at phone size.
